accountantsReport.statement: In accordance with your instructions, we have compiled these unaudited financial statements from the accounting records and from information and explanations you have given us.

smallCompany.accountingPolicies: The financial statements have been prepared under the historical cost convention.
smallCompany.goingConcernStatement: The directors expect the company to have enough resources to continue in operation for the foreseeable future, so the financial statements are prepared on a going concern basis.
smallCompany.revenueRecognitionPolicy: Turnover is the amount receivable for software and services provided in the year, excluding VAT.
smallCompany.tangibleFixedAssetsPolicy: Tangible fixed assets are measured at cost less accumulated depreciation. Computer equipment is depreciated at 33% a year on cost.
smallCompany.impairmentPolicy: At each reporting date the company reviews its assets for signs of impairment. An asset whose carrying value is more than its recoverable amount is written down to that amount.
smallCompany.financialInstrumentsPolicy: The company has only basic financial instruments. Debtors, cash and creditors are measured at the undiscounted amount of cash the company expects to receive or pay.
smallCompany.taxPolicy: The tax expense for the year comprises current tax, recognised in profit or loss.
smallCompany.currentIncomeTaxPolicy: The current income tax charge is calculated on the tax rates and laws enacted or substantively enacted by the reporting date.
smallCompany.dividendPolicy: Dividends are recognised as a liability in the period in which they are declared.
